title: Urban heat interpolation with uncertainty-aware vulnerability screening
prompt: Use fixtures/urban-heat.json to interpolate the projected temperature observations with ordinary kriging. Preserve the declared variogram model, produce outputs/temperature-surface.json and outputs/uncertainty-surface.json, summarize all twelve census zones in outputs/census-summary.csv using elderly population rates rather than counts, and select high-risk zones only when both heat and vulnerability thresholds pass and uncertainty is within the declared ceiling. Write outputs/urban-heat-map.svg as an accessible map, outputs/validation-report.json with empirical variogram diagnostics and four-fold spatial block cross-validation, and outputs/provenance.json with CRS, units, model, grid, and decision-rule provenance.
invariants: All interpolation distances and raster areas use projected EPSG:32636 metre units.
The empirical variogram and declared exponential model remain explicit and auditable.
Validation uses four spatial blocks rather than random-only observation splits.
Census vulnerability uses elderly population divided by total population, never raw counts.
High-risk selection requires temperature, elderly-rate, and maximum-uncertainty gates.
The map exposes units, manual temperature classes, uncertainty exclusions, and accessible text.
